steps.title: Our stock in three hospitals

steps.title: What we decided last time
steps.purpose: Recall past decisions on this drug from H-MEM, with who approved them.

options.title: Buy from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc.
options.detail: Not on FDA's shortage list today. Its label names no plant we could place.
options.why: Same product, but the plant record is thin or recent.

explanation.headline: No FDA shortage signal for idarubicin hydrochloride at our plants; Corvale East has 13 days on hand

sentences.text: Corvale East holds 45 units with a daily use of 3.6, providing 13 days on hand.

rejected.text: FDA's shortage list shows no signal for idarubicin hydrochloride at our plants as of 2026-10-21.
The recommended action is to buy from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today.
Hikma's label does not name a plant we could place for supply tracking.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Decision on carboplatin: restrict carboplatin to curative-intent regimens while on allocation; oncology reviews each palliative order. Rationale: Two suppliers on allocation and under 10 days on hand at Corvale General (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.

Q-dfcc7b.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%idarubicin%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%idarubicin%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-1c48bc.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('d31254be-6bd2-4ac1-acab-bc00e2209d28') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-4103f3.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%idarubicin%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-6dde5e.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%idarubicin%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-aa465d.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%idarubicin%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-808a5c.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-de2bfd.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-4794e1.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-d178e9.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('meitheal') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%idarubicin%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-0af9fb.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('71288018620')
